name: Jezzam
description_en:
Jezzam is an online booking service for staff appointments, classes and bookable resources such as rooms, courts or equipment. A staff member is a bookable person; a resource is a bookable non-person asset. Services can depend on combinations of those entities.

Its calendar integration has a particularly important boundary: the documented subscription feed publishes Jezzam bookings outward in one direction. It should not be mistaken for a live two-way availability system that imports every external appointment.
description_zh:
Jezzam 是面向员工预约、班课及房间、球场、设备等可预订资源的在线服务。员工是可预约的人，资源是可预订的非人员资产；服务可以依赖这些实体的组合。

其日历集成有一个重要边界：文档中的订阅源单向向外发布 Jezzam 预约，不能将其理解为会导入所有外部日程的实时双向可用性系统。

core_features.explanation_en: Define schedules for people and non-person resources, including combinations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为人员及非人员资源定义日程，并支持资源组合。

core_features.explanation_en: Publish selected booking details to external calendar apps through iCal links.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过 iCal 链接向外部日历发布所选预约资料。

core_features.explanation_en: Collect booking data and let customers manage their booking profile.
core_features.explanation_zh: 收集预约资料，并让客户管理预约档案。

sections.title_en: Example: a hall with divisible rooms
sections.title_zh: 示例：可分隔房间的活动场地
sections.en:
A community venue might sell a small room separately or combine two rooms into a larger service. Jezzam’s resource page explicitly describes resource combinations, while its pricing FAQ distinguishes bookable staff from non-person resources. Model the rooms and their dependency before making services available.

As an evaluation, reserve the combined space and check whether an incompatible small-room booking is still possible. Then cancel and inspect availability again. This is a proposed test of the chosen configuration, not a verified result. If an instructor is also required, model that person separately from the room.
sections.zh:
社区场地可能单独出租小房间，也可能将两个房间合为较大的服务。资源页明确介绍资源组合，定价 FAQ 区分可预约员工与非人员资源。开放服务前，应先建模房间及依赖关系。

建议评估时预订组合空间，再查看是否仍能产生不相容的小房间预约；随后取消并重新查看可用性。这是针对配置的测试建议，未经实际验证。如果还需要教师，应把人员与房间分别建模。

sections.title_en: A feed can be stale and its link is sensitive
sections.title_zh: 订阅可能延迟，链接需要保护
sections.en:
Jezzam publishes one-way iCal subscriptions for a staff member, a resource or the whole account. The receiving calendar determines refresh frequency; the documentation warns that Google may refresh only once or twice daily and Jezzam cannot control that interval. This is vendor-documented guidance, not a benchmark of today’s Google behavior.

The feed can include or exclude customer details and custom-form data. The page says iCal has no default authentication and recommends sharing subscription URLs only with trusted people; links can be disabled, deleted or regenerated. Do not put a detailed private feed on a public website. External calendar edits do not establish a changed Jezzam booking.
sections.zh:
Jezzam 可为员工、资源或整个账户发布单向 iCal 订阅。刷新频率由接收日历决定；文档提醒 Google 可能每天仅刷新一两次，Jezzam 无法控制间隔。这是厂商文档提示，未经对当前 Google 行为的基准测试。

订阅可选择包含或排除客户详情及自定义表单数据。页面表示 iCal 默认无认证，建议仅向可信人员分享订阅网址，链接可禁用、删除或重新生成。不能将含私人详情的订阅放到公开网站；修改外部日历也不能证明 Jezzam 预约已变化。

sections.en:
The GBP pricing view shows £9.50 per month including one staff member or resource and 400 confirmed bookings created per month. Each additional staff/resource and each extra block of 400 bookings is listed at £2.50 per month. Services, courses, classes and events are listed as unlimited, which does not remove the booking or staff/resource charges.

For illustration, one base entity plus two extra entities and one additional 400-booking block would total £17 per month before any unverified tax or payment-provider costs. That is arithmetic from published components, not a quote. The service offers a 30-day trial without a card and explicitly no permanent free plan. Cancellation and suspension are distinct: the latter pauses payments with later reactivation.
sections.zh:
英镑定价视图显示每月 £9.50，包含一位员工或一个资源，以及每月创建 400 次已确认预约。每额外员工/资源、每额外 400 次预约均列为每月 £2.50。服务、课程、班课和活动不限，不会取消预约及员工/资源计费。

举例，基础一个实体，加两个实体及额外 400 次预约的月度增量，合计 £17，未含尚未核实的税费及处理商费用。这是按公开组件计算，并非报价。服务提供无需信用卡的 30 天试用，并明确没有永久免费档。取消与暂停不同，后者停止付款并允许之后恢复。

sections.title_en: Start with scheduling rules and account policy
sections.title_zh: 从排程规则及账户政策入门
sections.en:
Prepare resources, staff, operating hours, per-service constraints and booking form fields. Publish one representative service, then inspect the customer portal and a private calendar feed. When a feed seems outdated, first inspect the source booking and receiving calendar’s refresh behavior; repeatedly changing the booking can obscure the cause.

The pricing FAQ describes in-app support requests and a first-paid-month money-back policy, with no general refunds beyond that. Confirm terms before a longer migration. Resource-dependent service businesses are the relevant evaluation audience; organizations requiring instant external-calendar conflict ingestion should not assume the one-way feed solves that need. No self-hosted licence or recovery procedure was verified.
sections.zh:
准备资源、员工、营业时间、各服务限制及预约表单字段。先开放一种代表性服务，再检查客户门户与私人日历订阅。订阅看似过期时，应先检查来源预约及接收日历的刷新行为；反复修改预约可能掩盖原因。

定价 FAQ 介绍应用内支持工单，以及首个付费月退款保证，此后没有通用退款。较大迁移前应确认条款。依赖资源的服务业务是相关评估对象；要求即时导入外部日历冲突的组织，不能认为单向订阅满足需求。未核实自托管许可或恢复流程。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No account, resource-combination conflict, payment/refund, feed refresh, export or recovery test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际测试账户、资源组合冲突、付款/退款、订阅刷新、导出或恢复。

research_gaps.en: Exact tax treatment, payment-provider fees, complete contract/licence and data-retention terms remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体税务处理、支付服务商费用、完整合同/许可及数据保留条款未核实。
